newsitem.title: SPAIN: Tabacalera sees gov't sale late 1997 - RFTV.
newsitem.headline: Tabacalera sees gov't sale late 1997 - RFTV.

text.p: The sale of the Spanish government's 52-percent stake in cigarette-maker Tabacalera could take place in late 1997 or early 1998, the firm's financial director Calixto Rios told Reuters Financial Television on Monday.
However he said the government has not directly informed the company of any date.

"We didn't receive any indication about the timing of the privatisation... according to the indication given to the market by the government it seems that it's going to be late 1997 or early 1998," Rios said.

Regarding a government hike in taxes on tobacco announced earlier this year --which Tabacalera has not passed on to retail prices of Virginia tobacco-- Rios said any move by the firm will depend on what its competitors decide to do.
"We are watching carefully the market situation, and we will move accordingly," he said.
